scripts.build:app: npm run build-ts && npm run build-renderer
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:app && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.start: npm run build-ts && npm run build-renderer && electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,ts,app -c blue,magenta,green "vite" "tsc -w" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist/main/index.js dist/main/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 nodemon --watch dist/main/index.js --watch dist/main/preload.js --ext js --ignore dist/main/**/*.map --delay 250ms --exec 'electron . --dev --no-sandbox'"
scripts.dev:electron: cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 nodemon --watch dist/main/index.js --watch dist/main/preload.js --ext js --ignore dist/main/**/*.map --delay 250ms --exec 'electron . --dev --no-sandbox'
